pattern: ^\[Win32App\]\[DetectionActionHandler\] Policy with id: {GUID} is expected to have enforcement state: Detected\.
description: Marks IME's check right after an install. IME logs this line only for the app it has just installed, before that check's result line; the agent reports that result (IME-DETECTION-RESULT) as app_post_install_detection and keeps detectionResult as the check before the install. Other apps of the same dependency chain are checked in the same run without this line. A failed check is IME's error 0x87D1041C (IME-ERROR-REPORT).
